name: Yangtze Three Gorges
hl: Sail 200 km through Qutang, Wu and Xiling gorges — the most storied river canyon on Earth
Docking stops: Fengdu Ghost City, Shennong Stream tributary and the Three Gorges Dam
Sunrise and sunset from your balcony as limestone cliffs slide past
how: Fly or rail to Chongqing, board the cruise; disembark at Yichang and rail to Wuhan or fly on.
tips: Choose a 'downstream' cruise (Chongqing→Yichang) for extra sailing time
Book 1–3 months ahead for peak season cabins
hotel: On-board cabins (standard to luxury) are included in the cruise fare.

plan.title: Gorge deep-dive
plan.tip: Descend to the river floor first, then climb the cliff walkway for the overview.
steps: Gate → shuttle/boat to the gorge mouth
River-level trail or boat through the narrows
Cliff plank-walk / glass walkway — the aerial view
Waterfall & cave stops on the way back; base lunch
